# BAD-060 — Re-point the web-api comments outside BAD-049's PR 4 list

## Brief
Four comments outside BAD-049's planned sweep still name scripts/web-api.js for code that now lives in scripts/web-api/ modules; they mislead the next reader the same way the swept ones did. They were not in spike BAD-036 section 7's PR 4 list, so PR 4 left them alone.

Evidence: src/rendergate.js:73 '(as scripts/web-api.js does)' and test/rendergate.test.js:59 '(scripts/web-api.js is one)' name the caller that threads gateToken's options object, which is now scripts/web-api/gate.js's gateOf. src/renderstore.js:8 "scripts/web-api.js's DELETE /session/:id routes to it": the handler is now deleteSession in scripts/web-api/route-session.js (the entry still dispatches it). scripts/web-local.js:13 '(web-api.js /api/dev-account ...)': the handler is devAccount in scripts/web-api/route-dev.js. src/rendergate.js:15 'scripts/web-api.js hold[s] no rule of their own' is still true but now covers the modules too. Spike section 2e lists all of these as going stale when the functions move. Comment-only edits; npm test covers the files.
